title: Brand values
slide_intent: Translate named values into actions people can recognize. Short behavior descriptions let a reader distinguish neighboring concepts.
strategic_value: Slack can give teams a shared vocabulary for choices about how they work with colleagues and customers.
demonstration: Six entries pair a bold value name and a short cluster of qualities with a paragraph describing behavior. The two columns carry three values each.
practical_value: Use the descriptions to distinguish, for example, practicing courtesy from improving craft when explaining a team decision.

content_islands.name: Page heading
content_islands.spec: Place the small bold title at upper left above a horizontal rule spanning the page.

content_islands.name: Values matrix
content_islands.spec: Set Empathy, Courtesy and Craftsmanship down the left column and Playfulness, Solidarity and Thriving down the right. In each block, follow the heading with short qualities and a paragraph of actions.
